mapper.select: SELECT FINPROD_ID AS code, FINPROD_NAME AS name, FINPROD_ABBR AS shortName, FINPROD_TYPE AS hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FP.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

SELECT distinct FP.FINPROD_ID AS code, FP.FINPROD_ID AS name, FP.FINPROD_ID AS shortName, FP.FINPROD_TYPE AS hidCode FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FP WHERE FP.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND (FP.BRANCH = '0' OR FP.BRANCH IS NULL)
